action: ThaiCERT advises promptly checking and updating vulnerable network devices such as Fortinet equipment, tightening controls on external access, segmenting IT and OT networks and monitoring continuously for unusual activity.

plain: ThaiCERT says, citing the Wall Street Journal, that US authorities are investigating attacks on commercial ships, and that as many as 50 vessels may have been targeted. No link to any country is confirmed.
summary: ThaiCERT's bulletin, citing a Wall Street Journal report, says US authorities are investigating attacks on commercial ships carrying oil, LPG, chemicals and hazardous materials. It says as many as 50 vessels may have been targeted, with reported network intrusions, bomb threats, extortion and threatening messages aimed at halting US-origin shipments. Officials are reportedly examining possible links to Iran and Russia; no evidence confirms them yet.
title: ThaiCERT, citing WSJ: US probes attacks on commercial ships, 50 vessels given as possible number targeted

validation.note: Only ThaiCERT's relay of the WSJ report was read; the WSJ and Security Affairs originals were not found or read.
